mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( receiver_id, actor_id, order_id, chat_room_id, chat_message_id, post_id, comment_id, review_id, review_reply_id, user_coupon_id, notification_type, title, content, delivery_scope, is_read, read_at, event_key, created_at ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{actorId}, #{orderId}, #{chatRoomId}, #{chatMessageId}, #{postId}, #{commentId}, #{reviewId}, #{reviewReplyId}, #{userCouponId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{deliveryScope}, #{isRead}, #{readAt}, #{eventKey}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.notification_type AS type, n.title, n.content, n.is_read AS isRead, n.created_at AS createdAt, n.order_id AS orderId, n.chat_room_id AS chatRoomId, COALESCE(n.post_id, c.post_id) AS postId, n.comment_id AS commentId, n.review_id AS reviewId, n.user_coupon_id AS userCouponId FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.id = n.comment_id WHERE n.receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY n.created_at desc LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = true, read_at = NOW() WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT true FROM notifications WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND event_key = #{eventKey} LIMIT 1 )
SELECT phone FROM members WHERE id = #{receiverId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_deliveries ( notification_id, recipient, template_code, provider_message_id, status, failure_reason, sent_at, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{notificationId}, #{recipient}, #{templateCode}, #{providerMessageId}, #{status}, #{failureReason}, #{sentAt}, #{deliveredAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
